notes: «وَ رُوِيَ» is passive with no named transmitter before «عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ», so the chain starts at Shu'ayb; the passive subject is not named
«أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ» is passive; the Imam after «عَنْ» is a narrator (not imam_in_text), since he is named inside the chain
«قَالَ قُلْتُ» — the first-person questioner is not named, so not added; the speaker of the Imam's words is unclear (rule 6, rule 11)
